inherits.note: Body, guard and every non-fastener lid value are read from R9-FITFIX-01 unchanged. Only the plate/frame fastener below replaces the M3 bore, nut pocket and boss.

nut_source.status: User-attached product dimension table (ss-2026-10-21-011738.png, row M5), transcribed in issue #123. Catalogue values, not a physical measurement or tolerance guarantee.
nut_source.type: M5 nylon-insert lock nut (same family as ZB40)

design_envelope.note: Design envelope from the table maxima. The pocket is not sized to the 7.83 photo value.

adopted_reasons.through_hole: Issue start value 5.5 kept: M5 normal clearance, same as the R6/R9 5.5 body holes.
adopted_reasons.pocket_af: Changed from the 8.5 start value to 8.4. 8.4 still clears the 8.0 envelope by 0.4 (0.2 per flat). With a nut whose corners are truncated like ISO 10511 (e_min/s = 8.79/8.0), a 7.68 across-flats nut reaches 4.22 mm corner radius: that locks against an 8.4 pocket (4.20 inscribed radius) but could spin in an 8.5 pocket (4.25). Sharp-corner nominal nuts lock in both. The N1 ladder coupon tests 8.3/8.4/8.5 physically.
adopted_reasons.pocket_effective_depth: Issue start value 5.5 kept: 0.5 over the 5.0 envelope height. The 0.2 overcut below the boss is not counted.
adopted_reasons.nut_wall_min: 1.6 = issue minimum 1.5 plus 0.1 margin; it sets the boss depth perpendicular to the edge.
adopted_reasons.plate_edge_to_axis: Moved inward from the M3 3.9 so an assumed 10 mm head stays fully on the plate (0.5 margin) and the side boss stays outside the 40HP rail/panel X range.
adopted_reasons.boss_half_length: M3 14 mm boss length kept; 7.0 exceeds hex corner radius + 1.6 wall (6.45).

assumptions.status: Variable assumptions. Screw head, washer and length were not identified from the product pages and were not measured.
